after.RouteNotes: CB: route replaced (guessed from endpoints) — the prior geometry began at the Mellitah O&G Tripoli office and ran onshore, ending about 19 km short of the complex; this asset is an offshore export line from a platform roughly 130 km out. Start coordinate derived by georeferencing the Area D (ex-NC41) location map in Mellitah O&G prequalification enquiry JPTPQ/018/21, scale-bar fit anchored on the Bouri platforms, +/- 10 km; that document specifies a new 32 in, 130 km gas sealine from PP E to Mellitah. End coordinate is the Mellitah complex in OSM. Path measures 134 km versus the sheet's 130 km. Graded very low rather than low because the platform endpoint is derived, not directly published. P6715 is the survivor of the P6708/P6715 duplicate pair.
